# Soft-wrapped paragraphs

The first paragraph
has three
source lines.

An *emphasized
phrase*, a **strong
phrase**, and a [link
label](https://example.com) can be joined.

A [reference
label][example] and `inline code`
can be joined without changing their syntax.

An escaped \<br>
is ordinary prose.

An inline `<br>`
is not an HTML break.

[example]: https://example.com
